apps.message:
feat: thanks and feedback as prepared e-mails (MVP)

## Intent

Without thanks the app overview makes little sense, and counting is postponed. The MVP should test whether thanks arrive with the simplest means: a prepared e-mail. The privacy notice must cover these e-mails before the first one arrives.

## Key changes

- "Danke sagen" opens a prepared e-mail to Danke-lernapps@beimir.net with subject and body per app; the body says the e-mail only tests whether thanks arrive and that thanks will later be counted with one click.
- "Im Unterricht", "Zu Hause" and the answers to "Wie lief es?" open an e-mail to Feedback-lernapps@beimir.net with the choice in the subject.
- A referral code (?welle=) is added to every e-mail.
- The links work without JavaScript, so the block is always shown; hints say that a click opens the mail program, name both addresses and link the privacy notice.
- The counter setting, the referral banner and the totals are gone until counting exists.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The privacy notice in lernapps.github.io (84247fd) must be live before the first e-mail arrives.

lernapps.github.io.message:
docs(privacy): thanks and feedback by e-mail

## Intent

Without thanks the app overview makes little sense, and counting is postponed. The MVP should test whether thanks arrive with the simplest means: a prepared e-mail. The privacy notice must cover these e-mails before the first one arrives.

## Key changes

- A new section "Danke und Rückmeldung per E-Mail" in German and English: we receive the e-mail only when it is sent, count it, pass the thanks on to the creator without the address, answer only on request and delete it once counted.
- The legal basis is legitimate interest.
- The stubs for AI tutors under the Mathe-Karte's old paths go away with it.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The e-mails come from the app overview in lernapps/apps (2764368).
